$comment: The project's harness settings and facts, one file. pnpm verify:harness-config holds it to .agents/contracts/harness-config.schema.json: an unknown key, a value the schema does not allow, or a missing setting fails the gate. See docs/harness.md section 3h.

identity.$comment: The names of this project, the one block a derived repository rewrites to name itself. Nothing in the template reads it yet. pnpm run init <slug> rewrites this block: product and repository become the slug, and packageScope @<slug>, the scope it gives every package; only owner/name in repository is left to set by hand.

workflow.$comment: Decision 40. Read by /init (Stage 6), which asks it; the template runs sdd, as AGENTS.md § Spec-driven changes says. The sdd prune of template.manifest.json sets odd.

delivery.$comment: Decision 38. Read by the architect's merge queue (.claude/skills/ticket-flow/SKILL.md rule 4, .claude/skills/refine-ticket/SKILL.md § Merge queue) and written by process-intake. The template ships manual.

backend.$comment: kind: supabase, own (the project's own backend, which the harness does not manage) or none. databaseTests applies to supabase only, and nothing reads it yet: F57 keeps its own setting in packages/supabase/package.json, which moves here once both have merged. The supabase prune of template.manifest.json sets none.

stack.$comment: Only the facts true under every prune: the web-next and mobile-expo prunes remove an app, so mobile and web are not recorded, and backend.kind holds the backend. Nothing reads them.
